newsitem.title: EGYPT: Silo firm yr net profit up 18 pct.
newsitem.headline: Silo firm yr net profit up 18 pct.

text.p: General Silos and Storage, partially privatised earlier this month, said on Thursday it made net after-tax profits of 47.856 million pounds ($14.1 million), 18.2 percent up on 40.489 million in the previous year. The years end June 30.

Distributed profits are 45 percent up at 40.598 million, equivalent to 4.06 pounds for each of the 10 million shares, which last traded on the Egyptian stock exchange at 42.00 pounds. The company did not say how it would distribute them.

The state sold 40 percent of General Silos and Storage earlier this month at 39.00 pounds a share. It says it will not give up majority control because the company works in a strategic sector -- storing and distributing subsidised wheat.
At the end of the year, shareholders' funds were worth 155.102 million pounds, six percent up on 146.325 million one year earlier.
From total after-tax profits, 7.258 million has been transferred to reserves, against 12.562 million in 1994/5.
The company will have a shareholders meeting on December 2.
